name: com.markus.gaussian-raytracing
description: Hardware ray tracing of layered 3D Gaussians and registered transmission meshes in HDRP. Includes import tools, setup diagnostics and a synthetic hybrid sample. Derived from UnityGaussianSplatting, the multi-layer anatomy renderer and NVIDIA vk_gaussian_splatting.

samples.description: Synthetic Gaussians, opaque receiver, glass and a moving occluder under one point light. After import: Tools > Gaussian Ray Tracing > Samples > Create Basic Hybrid Scene.
